The [[krait]] are spread out across its eastern hills and waterways, while [[simian]]s make their home in [[Arbor Bay ruins|the ancient ruins]] in the northwest section. Patrols of [[Wind Rider]]s circle the lake in the southwest. [[Ventari]] can be found on a small island near the center of the lake; his sanctuary is also home to the Pale Tree from which the firstborn [[gw2:sylvari|sylvari]] will eventually arise. ==NPCs==
